prompt: Objective: reduce emergency room waiting times. What you've learned: 40% of visits are non-urgent. Latest finding: nearby urgent care clinics have spare capacity in the evenings. What is the best next step?

options.text: Size how much sending evening cases to the clinics would cut waits
options.feedback: Right. Non-urgent demand and spare clinic capacity are both known. Next is how to connect them and how much it would shorten waits.

options.text: Size the share of non-urgent visits hour by hour, all week
options.feedback: Mostly answered: 40% are non-urgent. The new finding is where they could go.

options.text: Compare the ER's staffing with other hospitals
options.feedback: Secondary. The finding gives a way to cut demand.

options.text: Cost out an expansion of the ER
options.feedback: That ignores the finding: spare capacity already exists nearby.

explanation: 40% of visits are non-urgent and clinics have spare evening capacity. Next is how to route patients there and how much that would cut waiting times.
